reliable_gain: A bounded finite evidence/update construction with sound conditional loss bounds, explicit true/false/unresolved behavior, resource model and exact ordinary reconstruction.
exploratory_gain: Challenge partial enumeration, conflict, withdrawal, objective/domain change, growing-query defaults and unfair evidence access; seek sharper anytime or task-directed construction.
first_informative_check: Can interrupted finite case construction still return a conservative useful bound without treating visited cases as a complete source or granting free truth/consistency access?
likely_failure: Smuggling completeness or source accuracy into a supplied finite catalogue; confusing eventual receipt with anticipatory useful refinement.
rendering_work: Authorized formatting repair and renderer compatibility checks are O; concurrent delegated work adds zero principal time.
